display_long_description:
**Stream any VR game, app, or experience directly from your Meta Quest — no PC, no cables, no extra setup.**

With BeamXR Live, it’s easy to go live, chat with your audience, and share your world in real time.

[media]

**🔴 Go Live**

🎥 Stream any Quest game, app, or experience

🔴 Go live on Twitch or YouTube with one tap

⚙️ Stream to any RTMP platform

💬 See your live chat inside your headset

🎨 Personalise your stream with images, text, and more

🧑 Stream your Meta Avatar to just chat and hang out

Whether you’re showing off your skills in top titles, exploring new MR apps, or just chilling as your avatar - BeamXR Live makes it simple.

[media]


[media]

**⚠️ Known Issues (Early Access):**
- In some multiplayer games that use voice chat, your mic may not be heard on stream

We’re in early access and actively improving — your feedback helps shape what’s next. Join our Discord to stay in the loop:  https://discord.com/invite/beamxr

Thanks for streaming with BeamXR Live!
